snapshot.cross_check: $1.1987 last trade on Kraken, 3:36 AM MST (Kraken 24h range $1.1761 to $1.3205)

confirmed: XRP is about $1.20 early Friday, down about 9.3% over 24 hours and about 4.6% lower than 7 days ago, and about 15.8% below 30 days ago (CoinGecko snapshot, 3:36 AM MST; Kraken last trade $1.1987, 24h range $1.1761 to $1.3205). The broader crypto market also sold off overnight ahead of the US October jobs report due at 8:30 AM ET (6:30 AM MST).

Binance said on its official X account early Friday (about 2:08 AM MST) that the zero-knowledge proof for its latest Proof of Reserves is ready, so users can verify balances are backed at least 1:1 (Binance). That is the proof for the Nov 4 00:00 UTC snapshot covering 44 tokens. In Recovery Update #7 on Nov 4, Binance said about 98% of assets affected by the Oct 29 hack had been replenished from its own funds, with the remaining less-liquid tokens still being bought (Binance). Recovery Update #8 on Nov 5 reopened a third batch of withdrawals across six networks; Update #9 on Nov 6 continues more reopenings (Binance).

US spot XRP ETFs had no net flows on Thu Nov 5, a third flat day after Nov 3 and Nov 4, following about $529,510 of net outflows on Mon Nov 2 (SoSoValue via Crypto Radar Signals). Cumulative net inflows are about $1.81B; reported net assets about $1.41B on that dashboard.

The XRP Ledger's fixCleanup3_4_0 amendment went live Wednesday at 14:52 UTC (7:52 AM MST), at ledger 108,112,129 (XRPLWin via CoinDesk). It closes a flaw that, under certain conditions, let an account authorized only to burn an issuer's tokens also mint new ones. It affected issued tokens such as stablecoins, not XRP itself, and no exploitation has been publicly confirmed (CoinDesk).

Uphold launched RLUSD Earn on Nov 5, letting eligible customers earn a variable rate of up to 7% APY on Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin through the Uphold app via Morpho lending curated by Sentora; it is not a bank deposit and is not FDIC insured (Uphold via CCN, Nov 5).

crypto.news published a Nov 6 feature on Ripple and C2FO's supplier-financing plan that would settle Instant Pay on the XRP Ledger in RLUSD. Fees and reserves on the ledger still require XRP for operators, but the announced settlement currency is RLUSD, so invoice value alone does not imply proportional XRP demand (crypto.news, Nov 6).

On-exchange data: Binance's XRP reserves rose from about 2.35B to about 2.63B between Nov 3 and Nov 5 (about +280M XRP). The source of that increase (market buys, OTC, or internal moves) has not been confirmed by Binance (The Crypto Basic, CryptoQuant).

Democrats won control of both the House and the Senate in Tuesday's midterm elections (AP via Cointelegraph, Reuters). New members take office in January; analysts quoted by Reuters say a Democratic Congress may slow market-structure bills such as the stalled CLARITY Act.

Ripple and Coinbase announced Oct 28 that RLUSD can now be traded and held in the Coinbase app, Coinbase Exchange and Coinbase Prime, with 1:1 conversion from dollars, and deposits and withdrawals on the XRP Ledger, Base and Ethereum (Ripple, Oct 28). This is about the RLUSD stablecoin, not an XRP listing change.

Moody's rated RLUSD A2 long-term and P-1 short-term on Oct 27, citing reserves mostly in short-term US government assets and cash held at BNY, with a 103% coverage target; it also flagged that holders don't yet have a direct claim on reserves (Moody's, Decrypt, The Block).

BNY now supports XRP and RLUSD custody: Ripple and BNY announced Oct 27 that BNY's Digital Asset Custody platform now supports XRP and RLUSD for institutional clients. Plans to let BNY clients mint and redeem RLUSD directly, and a tokenized trade finance pilot with C2FO on the XRP Ledger, are still subject to approvals (The Block, Cointelegraph).

Ripple's November escrow cycle is complete: 1 billion XRP was released at 00:00 UTC Nov 1, and Ripple re-locked 700 million XRP in three new escrows that open in June and July 2029, leaving 300 million XRP outside escrow, the same pattern as September and October (TokenPost, Coinpaper, Whale Alert). That does not show the 300 million were sold.
not_confirmed: The CLARITY Act has not passed the Senate: the 'Senate Banking Committee advances CLARITY Act 15 to 9' posts recycle a May 14, 2026 vote, and the full Senate then failed to advance it 49 to 50 on Sept 15. 'Trump signs crypto bill' posts are false. 'U.S. has signed a bill to replace FedNow with a next-generation payment system powered by XRP' and 'RealToken on XRP Ledger will unlock $650 trillion on Nov 14' posts are false; no such law or unlock exists. '$28,000 per XRP' price predictions and 'if you hold 500+ XRP you might already be a millionaire' posts are speculation with no source. 'Convert your funds into XRP as banks go cashless' and 'get money out of the bank / financial reset' posts are engagement bait with no official basis. 'Whales now control nearly 74% of supply' does not match the latest Santiment figure of about 68.5% for 10M+ XRP wallets. BlackRock's appearance at Swell is a digital-assets director on an asset-manager panel, not a BlackRock XRP deal. No outlet confirms the '$60 billion' or '$73 billion in XRP transfers overnight' posts or the 'Trump met with Ripple' posts. 'XRP hit $37,000 on Bybit' posts have no evidence; XRP trades near $1.20 on every major venue. 'The Fed is being told to stand down as XRP gets the green light' has no basis. 'Reset is live' countdowns, 'QFS card' help desks, airdrops and move-your-coins or message-me-for-a-guide offers fit common scam patterns. 'North Korea's $6.3 billion XRP heist' posts are wrong: the $6.3B was taken from Binance hot wallets across many networks and assets, not XRP alone. 'XRP shorts on Bitfinex surge 652.89% to 468.2 MILLION' does not match Bitfinex's public margin data. 'Central banks agreed on a $5,000 set price for XRP' has no source. 'Explosive Goldman Sachs connection to XRP' is a teaser for a video with no document. 'Bloomberg spotlights XRP in 10 early races' misreads a Bloomberg election headline about House districts. 'Garlinghouse confirmed Ripple will become a major SWIFT shareholder by Nov 24' has no source. '$196.88 per XRP within days' posts label themselves rumors and give no basis. Details are in the rumors section.

news.headline: Binance: zero-knowledge proof for latest Proof of Reserves is ready
news.summary: Binance posted early Friday that the zk-proof for its latest PoR is ready so users can verify balances are backed at least 1:1. It applies to the Nov 4 00:00 UTC snapshot covering 44 tokens.

news.headline: Ripple wants to pay suppliers in RLUSD. Where does XRP fit?
news.summary: Feature on Ripple and C2FO Instant Pay settling supplier financing on the XRP Ledger in RLUSD. Operators still need XRP for fees and reserves; invoice dollars do not equal XRP demand one-for-one.

news.headline: The October jobs report is out Friday. Here's everything to expect
news.summary: BLS releases October nonfarm payrolls Friday at 8:30 AM ET. Dow Jones consensus expects about 59,000 jobs and unemployment holding near 4.2%. Not released yet at this refresh.

news.headline: Uphold launches RLUSD Earn, offering up to 7% APY on Ripple's stablecoin
news.summary: Uphold says eligible customers can earn a variable rate of up to 7% APY on RLUSD via Morpho lending curated by Sentora. Not a bank deposit; not FDIC insured; balance can fall.

news.headline: XRP reserves on Binance spike by about 280M post-hack
news.summary: CryptoQuant-linked data show Binance XRP reserves rising from about 2.35B to 2.63B between Nov 3 and Nov 5. Binance has not said whether the increase came from market buys, OTC, or internal transfers.

news.headline: Binance Recovery Update #8: third withdrawal batch reopens
news.summary: Update #8 (03:04 UTC Nov 5) began reopening 69 network-asset pairs across Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain, Base, TRON, Polygon and SUI after security checks. No new replenishment figure; last stated position remains about 98%.

news.headline: XRP Ledger fixes a disclosed bug that could have led to the creation of new tokens
news.summary: fixCleanup3_4_0 went live Nov 4 at 14:52 UTC. It stops accounts allowed only to burn issued tokens from also minting them; XRP itself was unaffected and no exploit has been confirmed.

news.headline: US crypto ETF flows Nov 5: XRP flat; BTC outflows heavy
news.summary: SoSoValue data for Nov 5 show XRP spot ETF net flow $0 (third flat day). BTC ETFs about −$430M; ETH about −$100M. XRP cumulative net inflows about $1.81B.

news.headline: Binance posts Nov 4 reserve snapshot; proof now generated
news.summary: Recovery Update #7: about 98% of affected assets replenished; 44-token snapshot at 00:00 UTC Nov 4. The zk-proof Binance estimated at 50–60 hours was announced ready on Nov 6.

news.headline: Crypto tracks stocks higher after Democrat midterm wins
news.summary: Crypto recovered from overnight losses after Democrats won both chambers. Binance customers had withdrawn a net $4.72B since the weekend reopening as of Tuesday.

news.headline: Ripple CEO says RLUSD competes with other stablecoins, not XRP
news.summary: Garlinghouse replied on X on Nov 3: 'RLUSD isn't competing with XRP. It's competing with other stablecoins.' RLUSD payments don't automatically create XRP demand.

news.headline: 2026 US midterm election: Democrats win both chambers
news.summary: Democrats won the House (per AP) and the Senate. Results could affect the stalled CLARITY Act and bring more scrutiny of Trump-linked crypto ventures.

claims.claim: 🚨‼️BOOOOOOOOOM! JUST IN‼️ U.S. HAS SIGNED A BILL TO REPLACE FEDNOW WITH A NEXT-GENERATION PAYMENT SYSTEM POWERED BY #XRP!! ON NOV 14TH, REALTOKEN ON XRP LEDGER WILL UNLOCK $650 TRILLION...
claims.check: No such bill has been signed, FedNow has not been replaced, and there is no $650 trillion RealToken unlock on Nov 14. Classic engagement-bait with countdown language and no primary source.

claims.claim: 🚨 XRP WHALE ALERT! $28,000 PER XRP?! THE BOLD PRICE PREDICTION MAKING WAVES... Get your XRP out of any exchanges...
claims.check: A video teaser with no named analyst, model or document. XRP trades near $1.20 on major venues. 'Move coins off exchanges' language matches common engagement and scam patterns.

claims.claim: 🚨 JUST IN 🇺🇸 : As banks shift toward a cashless system, XRP is emerging as the future of digital transactions. Convert your funds into XRP
claims.check: No bank, regulator or Ripple statement supports a cashless mandate that requires converting into XRP. Advice to 'convert your funds' is not news.

claims.claim: 🚨JUST IN: Former JP Morgan exec. says Ripple has the BIGGEST financial incentive of anyone to push $XRP to a significantly higher price because of its massive XRP holdings.
claims.check: Ripple's large XRP holdings are public and long-known; a commentator restating an incentive is not a new corporate disclosure or price catalyst. No named former JPMorgan executive or date is given in the post text.

claims.claim: 🔔📉BREAKING NEWS: XRP DROPS 10% REACHING A 30 DAY LOW OF $1.17, BUT TRADERS SEE 80%+ UPSIDE ... Kalshi traders are forecasting a price of $2.14 by the end of 2026.
claims.check: The ~10% daily drop and a print near $1.17 match Kraken's 24h low around $1.176 (CoinGecko/Kraken). Calling Kalshi odds a 'forecast' overstates a prediction-market price; it is not a guarantee of 80% upside.

claims.claim: JUST IN: $XRP shorts on Bitfinex surge 652.89% to 468.2 MILLION. If price moves against them, the squeeze could be explosive.
claims.check: Bitfinex's public margin stats show about 349,000 XRP short (about $460K), up about 22% in 24 hours, versus about 5.2M XRP long. Nothing near 468 million.

claims.claim: JUST IN: Banker claims the central banks agreed upon a $5000 set price for $XRP.
claims.who: Small accounts on X, Nov 4 to 5
claims.check: No named banker, document or central bank statement. XRP trades freely near $1.20 on every major venue; 'set price' posts are a long-running pattern with no evidence.

claims.who: Large community account on X, Nov 5
claims.check: Accurate, and it is a repost of CoinDesk's headline. The fix went live Nov 4 and affected issued tokens such as stablecoins, not XRP itself; no exploit has been confirmed.
